definitions.identity: Current moving flight snapshots; not distinct vehicles across road links.
definitions.contribution: Positive S-minus-T count loss is worse; weighted contributions use 1/(6*N_seed_scope).
definitions.attribution: Unique net-changing context receives its whole edge loss change; multiple contexts remain joint. Each partition separately reconstructs total.
definitions.probability: Source CDF recovered as 2*S_raw-T_raw only where source_n>0; differences describe fitted predictive heads, not physical causality.
definitions.prior: 20/(20+n) is the physical prior fraction; source/target head differences can include data-distribution and prior-strength differences.
